Dashboard Guide

Purpose
This dashboard provides a simple overview of sales performance.

How to Read the Dashboard
• Total Sales shows the overall sales amount.
• Total Profit shows the overall profit.
• Total Orders shows the number of orders.
• Sales by Category compares sales across product categories.
• Sales by Region compares sales across different regions.
• Monthly Sales Trend shows how sales change over time.
• Use the Region slicer to filter the dashboard by region.

Dashboard Tools
Excel PivotTables, PivotCharts, and Slicer
